rv.q: This show hits on all cylinders.
The Love Object is a perfect time capsule for this fall theatre scene and one sure to entertain.
If you are open to seeing a quality new work, making its World Premiere!, this is a great opportunity to do so.

cn.t: Critics praise this intimate 89-minute drama for its sharp direction and powerful exploration of female pop stars grappling with hypersexualization and fractured friendship in the tabloid era.
